newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Skoda plans to make two car models in Russia.
newsitem.headline: Skoda plans to make two car models in Russia.

text.p: Czech car maker Skoda, a unit of Volkswagen AG, is planning to produce two passenger car models in Russia next year, a spokesman told Reuters on Thursday.
Skoda aims to produce tens of thousands of Felicia and Octavia cars at Russian car and truck plants that are operating at less than full capacity, said Melan Smetny in Mlada Boleslav/Prague.
He said the amount Skoda will invest is still unclear, but added that the company does not plant to build or buy its own Russian plants.
In Poland, Skoda expected to sell 16,000 Felicia cars built in Posen, twice as many as this year, Smetny said.
